data.one_liner: Stream-based communication pattern abstraction for decoupled messaging between classes and logic components.
data.what_it_does: Provides mixins like Listener, Sender, MultiListener, and BLoC integrations (ListenerCubit, StateSender) that allow classes and state management components to broadcast and receive messages without passing explicit callbacks or stream references.
use_when: You need decoupled communication between disparate BLoCs, Cubits, or non-UI logic classes.
You want to avoid manually wiring up and disposing of StreamControllers and StreamSubscriptions between controllers.
avoid_when: You prefer direct method calls or tightly coupled references for simplicity.
Your architecture does not use BLoC or stream-based patterns.
strengths: Eliminates boilerplate code for connecting streams between logic classes.
Built-in support for BLoC and Cubit integration.
Supports initial message handling and covariant message types.
weaknesses: Can obscure direct data flow and dependencies if overused across a large codebase.
Requires careful lifecycle management (calling cancel/dispose or using ListenerCubit).

alternatives.name: bloc
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want standard state management and event handling without global message bus abstractions.
